raw.briefTitle: A study for adults with type 2 diabetes on metformin
raw.briefSummary: Tests a new medicine for type 2 diabetes.
raw.eligibilityCriteria:
Inclusion Criteria:
- Diagnosis of type 2 diabetes
- On a stable dose of metformin for at least 3 months
- HbA1c between 7.0% and 10.5%

Exclusion Criteria:
- Pregnant or lactating

criteria.sourceText: On a stable dose of metformin for at least 3 months

raw.briefTitle: An insulin pump study that excludes type 2 diabetes
raw.briefSummary: Insulin pump for type 1 diabetes only.
raw.eligibilityCriteria:
Inclusion Criteria:
- Clinical diagnosis of type 1 diabetes

Exclusion Criteria:
- Diagnosis of type 2 diabetes

raw.briefTitle: A women-only study of a new treatment
raw.eligibilityCriteria:
Inclusion Criteria:
- Able to attend all study visits

criteria.sourceText: Able to attend all study visits
